QuestInfo.0: You decided to wait until Kaling finds the case files, wondering what kind of problem will be thrown at you next.
QuestInfo.1: It seems that a Faceless Monster has been seen wandering the streets of town. Meet with #b#p3001603##k in #r#m410000200##k to hear further details of this strange case.
